_help: Biome template carried over from animated-succotash (28 Oct 2026). Climate only: the real-species plant lists were removed, because this game uses its own invented plant families (docs/DESIGN.md §C). climate.temp_c is mean annual °C; moisture is 0 (bone dry) to 1 (waterlogged); altitude_m where given.
name: Badlands
notes: Eroded clay and shale slopes mostly bare, with junipers in ravines, low sage and prickly pear on benches and short grasses in the flats; Dakota/Montana badlands with Bardenas Reales (Spain) and Patagonian analogues.
